games.headline: Oops cruises past Dena's Team 🏈
article: Oops beat Dena's Team 🏈 132.10 to 117.00 in Week 5, a solid win decided by 15.10 points.

Oops put up 132.10 this week, 17.5 over their projected 114.6. Drake Maye carried them with 46.5 points, over a third of the team's total, 24.9 over his projection. Malik Nabers (23.6) and Aaron Jones Sr. (17.2) were the other big contributors.
Dena's Team 🏈 put up 117.00 this week, 7.3 over their projected 109.7. Brock Purdy led the way with 19.6, and Braelon Allen added 18.1.
At quarterback, Drake Maye (46.5) outdueled Brock Purdy (19.6).
Oops moves to 3-2 (7th place). Dena's Team 🏈 falls to 2-3 (8th).

Up next in Week 6: Oops takes on Stroud and Proud (3-2), coming off a 17.9-point win over The Canberra Mob. Dena's Team 🏈 gets The Canberra Mob (1-4, losers of 4 straight), coming off a 17.9-point loss to Stroud and Proud.

games.headline: Stroud and Proud takes care of The Canberra Mob
article: Stroud and Proud beat The Canberra Mob 87.90 to 70.00 in Week 5, a solid win decided by 17.90 points.

Stroud and Proud managed 87.90 this week, 27.3 under their projected 115.2 and the 3rd-lowest score of the week. Jaxon Smith-Njigba carried them with 20.3 points, 3.5 over his projection. Sam LaPorta (17.3) and Will Reichard (13.0) were the other big contributors.

The Canberra Mob managed 70.00 this week, 27.2 under their projected 97.2 and the 2nd-lowest score of the week. Kyler Murray led the way with 20.1, and Matthew Golden added 17.3. The letdown was CeeDee Lamb, who managed 1.9 on a 15.5 projection.
The Canberra Mob left 14.00 points on the bench, with 49ers D/ST (15.0) sitting out.
At quarterback, Kyler Murray (20.1) outdueled Tyler Shough (-1.0).
Stroud and Proud moves to 3-2 (3rd place). The Canberra Mob falls to 1-4 (12th) and has now lost 4 in a row.

games.headline: King Henry handles The Dude Abides
article: King Henry beat The Dude Abides 147.30 to 120.40 in Week 5, a comfortable win decided by 26.90 points. It came down to the final game of the week, with King Henry up just 11.10 heading into Monday night.

King Henry put up 147.30 this week, 33.7 over their projected 113.7 and the 2nd-highest score of the week. Jacoby Brissett carried them with 30.1 points, 7.2 over his projection. Puka Nacua (29.2) and George Pickens (23.5) were the other big contributors.

Bucky Irving led The Dude Abides with 30.5, and Brock Bowers added 19.0. That would have beaten most teams this week. The Dude Abides just ran into King Henry. The letdown was Bo Nix, who managed 9.0 on a 19.0 projection.
The Dude Abides left 17.00 points on the bench, with Isaiah Likely (26.9) sitting out.
At quarterback, Jacoby Brissett (30.1) outdueled Bo Nix (9.0).
On Monday night: Puka Nacua (29.2), Kyren Williams (16.6), Dalton Kincaid (3.2).
King Henry moves to 3-2 (6th place). The Dude Abides falls to 3-2 (5th).
Up next in Week 6: King Henry takes on K9 Unit (4-1, winners of 3 straight), coming off a 41.0-point win over Ken. The Dude Abides gets Ken (1-4), coming off a 41.0-point loss to K9 Unit.
